reb-small-retail.dataset: 상업용부동산 임대동향조사 · 소규모 상가 · 서울 전체
reb-small-retail.geography: Seoul city / small retail survey; NOT a district, commercial area or site
reb-small-retail.license: Public statistical tables; R-ONE service terms apply; attribute 한국부동산원. Related public-data catalog states unrestricted use. No blanket microdata redistribution assumption.
reb-small-retail.limitations: Sample survey; 1F converted market rent with deposit conversion, excluding VAT/management fees. Small-retail market context does not establish host share, asking rent or installability. RSE not collected.
reb-small-retail.retrieval_method: unauthenticated documented sample API, exact quarter/region/item; each response declares one total row; classification-code catalog POST
reb-small-retail.transformation: retain source numeric precision; UI rounds one decimal; no ratios, imputation or score

seoul-stores.geography: published legacy commercial-area ID; code AND name validated against committed GIS
seoul-stores.limitations: Not commercial premises/available spaces; past quarterly activity, no causal health judgement. Polygon equality and new standard-unit crosswalk unproven.
seoul-stores.retrieval_method: official public 2025 ZIP, POST file seq20
seoul-stores.transformation: sum whole-store / opened / closed counts over distinct service categories in latest file quarter; do not average category rates
